title: MEN'S BASKETBALL | King Grace Postgame Radio Interview vs. UCF - 11/17/26
text: was intense, especially in the second half. What was it like playing in that one tonight? >> Uh, it was a great feeling just to be with the brothers, be with my team, be with my coach, just just to play in and be in environment. It was a great feeling. >> It was great to see you at the free throw line, especially when it mattered for this team. Talk to me about how much pride you take in shooting free throws and how important it was for your team tonight. >> It's simple as I work on it. I work on it every day. I got confidence it's going to go in every time I shoot it. So, just that easy. >> You take pride in your defense, too. You wound up on D'ore Johnson for the bulk of that second half. He had 20 at half. He wound up with six in the second half. What was the plan against him coming out of the locker room at halftime? >> Uh I think the plan was just to keep the ball out of his hands. Like whatever I can do to make sure he can't get it. You can't be effective if you don't got the ball. The ball scores. >> You've got a deeper team this year to work with than you guys had a season ago. Josh doesn't really get going offensively until the second half of this game. RJ steps up. You got to the free throw line. Tristan's great in the five spot tonight. How much confidence do you guys have that someone can step [music] up and get the job done when they have to? >> A lot. All the workouts, all the practice we've been over the summer. It's just like our connectivity. We also believe in each other highly, very highly. So, like we believe anybody on the team can have a good day. >> I know you had a tough night in West Virginia on Friday. How does it feel to walk out of here in your first true road game of the year with a win? >> Feels great. Feels great. Off to a good start. >> We'll see you on the airplane. Congratulations. >> Yes, sir.
